PRODUCT / SAAS + WEB APPS

A SaaS product needs more than a codebase.

A SaaS product needs more than a codebase. Define the product scope, build the right first version, prepare it for launch and make a plan for what happens after users arrive. We agree deliverables and responsibilities before work begins.

Every engagement is scoped with the people doing the work and the people who will use the result. We’ll make the goals, deliverables and unknowns clear before work starts.

Who is this for?

Founders and product teams with a software idea that needs a clear scope, a first release or continued development.

When is it useful?

Start when you are ready to define the problem, identify your users and agree what a useful first version should include.

01 / SHAPE

Define the first release

Align the problem, intended users and launch scope before committing to build.

02 / BUILD

Create the product

Develop the custom SaaS product or web app and its core foundations to the agreed scope.

03 / LAUNCH + CARE

Take it forward

Implement the agreed launch and go-to-market work, then support and maintain what is live.

WEB APP DEVELOPMENT

Web apps, built like
products.

Not every build is a product sold to many customers. As a web app development company, we also build browser-based applications with the same product discipline: dashboards, booking and billing tools, customer portals and internal systems. The work is the same shape as a SaaS build — agree the scope, build on a proven web stack, launch with measurement in place — but the app serves your business and its users rather than paying subscribers.

If the software is for one business and its own workflow, start from the custom software development page ↗. If you first need the smallest version that proves the idea, start with MVP development ↗.

See a web app we delivered end to end. Service Joy, a doorstep appliance-service booking platform for Chennai — complete design, build, platform and hosting by DotMiracle.

Before you decide

Good questions
deserve clear answers.

Here are a few things that may help you decide what to do next.

See how we work ↗
What if I only have an idea?

That is a starting point. We can discuss the problem, intended users and priorities to define what a useful first release could include.

Do you build web apps as well as SaaS products?

Yes. Dashboards, portals, booking and billing tools and other browser-based applications are built with the same process; the difference is whether the software is sold to many customers or serves one business.

How much will it cost and how long will it take?

Cost and timing depend on the product scope, integrations and requirements. These should be discussed and agreed before development begins.

What happens after the first release?

Launch and ongoing support can be considered as part of the engagement. The scope and responsibilities are agreed around the product’s needs.

The DotMiracle approach

Clear thinking before the build.
Honest measurement after.

We agree the intended outcome, project boundaries and what can realistically be measured. No promised rankings or guaranteed growth claims—just a clear process and accountable work.
